positions.title: Director of Technical Support
positions.description:
•	Managed all aspects of 20-employee technical support call center including hiring, training, scheduling, payroll, performance appraisal, and disciplinary action.
•	Improved cross-functional relationships and communications with Engineering, Sales, and Product Management.
•	Provided management level support, leadership, and resolution of all escalated customer satisfaction issues.
•	Designed and managed employee and department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
•	Reduced abandoned calls from 22% to less than 1%.
•	Increased calls answered in less than 60 seconds from 44% to 96% while experiencing 200% increase in historical support volumes.
•	Developed improved escalation and work flow processes, significantly improving employee productivity and efficiency.
•	Created internal feedback and communications tool enabling executive level exposure to department performance, goals, and successes.
•	Improved customer satisfaction and value by creating and implementing multiple feedback tools and Net Promoter Score initiative.
•	Successfully led department's initial ISO9000 certification.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative Tier I
positions.description:
•	Improved customer satisfaction by understanding and effectively resolving technical support requests.
•	Experience leveraging multiple technologies to provide improved customer support (e.g. online chat, Avaya phone systems, forums, knowledge base).
•	Worked extensively with Engineering and Product Development to identify and resolve product technical issues.
•	Contributed to and led effort to enhance company knowledge base.

positions.title: Helpdesk Representative Tier 2
positions.description:
•	Responded to inquiries concerning customer policies, company processes and procedures, and technical issues.
•	Provided technical support to over 500 insurance agents.
•	Supervised helpdesk by providing clarification of procedures and abnormal circumstances, researching and resolving problem insurance policies.
•	Developed and documented standard procedures for helpdesk representatives and agents.
•	Developed training material and presented training sessions for helpdesk representatives.

positions.title: Project Coordinator - Systems Management
positions.description:
•	Administrated e-mail management system, including initial implementation.
•	Provided management with detailed reports of e-mail trends and productivity.
•	Trained new writers and other staff members.

positions.title: Engineering Specifications Analyst
positions.description:
•	Converted engineering product drawings and floor plans to system database.
•	Compiled and analyzed the configuration standards to determine which features, parts, and AutoCAD drawings are needed to be included to build the product.
